notes: BUB1B compound-het candidate: c.2210T>G (p.Leu737Ter, stop_gained, ClinVar Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic VCV000533901.9, 2-star, MVA1-specific) + c.3006T>G (p.Asn1002Lys, missense, gnomAD singleton AC=1/1,461,878, in the kinase domain per UniProt O60566 - but ACMG PM1 was tested and is NOT applied, because that domain is not depleted of benign variation in gnomAD; variant 2 classifies as VUS). Both heterozygous. Phase (cis/trans) not directly resolvable from proband-only short-read WGS: variants are ~11kb apart, beyond short-read fragment span, and GATK/Sentieon local phasing (PGT/PID) found no informative reads connecting them. Presumed compound heterozygous based on: (1) known pathogenic LOF + extremely rare missense co-occurring in the same well-established recessive disease gene, matching the truncating-plus-missense allelic architecture reported for published biallelic BUB1B-MVA patients (Suijkerbuijk 2010), (2) full phenotype match (rhabdomyosarcoma, short stature, failure to thrive, IUGR) to the BUB1B-MVA spectrum, (3) extremely low prior probability of two independent rare BUB1B hits by chance. All frequency/clinical claims independently verified directly against gnomAD, ClinVar, and UniProt APIs (not just the VEP annotation proxy). A whole-gene deletion in trans is excluded by 8 heterozygous BUB1B calls spanning 53kb at normal depth; multi-exon deletions remain possible in five named intervals. Recommended first confirmatory test is a peripheral-blood karyotype with SNP microarray alongside: MVA is defined cytogenetically (mosaic aneuploidy across multiple chromosomes) and that assay has not been performed in this proband, so it tests the diagnosis rather than the phase, and the microarray also interrogates the deletion windows above. Parental Sanger sequencing for phase follows it. See methods report for full ACMG evidence, the PM1/PM2/PM3 derivations, and explicit discussion of this phasing limitation.

BUB1B deep intronic variant c.2679-1026A>G, absent from gnomAD (direct gnomAD v4 GraphQL query returns "Variant not found"), sits physically between the two primary candidates. Raised as a possible alternative second allele on rarity, gene and position, then tested: SpliceAI via the Ensembl VEP REST plugin returns 0.00 for all four delta scores (DS_AG/DS_AL/DS_DG/DS_DL) on every BUB1B transcript, i.e. no predicted acceptor or donor gain or loss, so the cryptic-splice/pseudoexon mechanism is not supported. (The Broad's standalone SpliceAI Lookup API was unreachable across three attempts; Ensembl's plugin serves the same scores.) EPCR lowered from 0.30 to 0.10 to reflect that negative result. Retained as an incidental finding to record the candidate that was assessed and downgraded, not as a competing causal hypothesis. Not scored as primary.
